integrity: The phase classification and asymptotic are proved analytically from exact derivatives and Taylor expansion. Numerical roots are consistency checks only and are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the equal-mean specialization and the switching of two already-known endpoint candidate mechanisms. It does not address unequal means, optimizer-law uniqueness, near-extremizer stability, monotonicity of the switching sequence, or a second-order asymptotic coefficient. An equivalent endpoint-crossing calculation could exist in older literature under different notation.
title: Finite-\(n\) phase boundary for the equal-mean Samuels extremizers
